lines.en: What should an observer carry forward? Not everything it has seen. Only what the next legal step will still need.
lines.zh: 一个观察者应该把什么带向未来？不是它见过的一切，只是下一个合法步骤仍然需要的东西。

lines.en: This volume studies three verbs: transport a phase along a path, remember only what a task demands, and complete finite readings into a limit, without pretending the limit was ever reached.
lines.zh: 这卷理论研究三个动词：沿路径运输相位，只记住任务要求的东西，把有限读数完备成极限，而不假装那个极限曾被真正到达。

lines.en: Transport, memory, completion. A mathematical inverse is not automatically an executable operation.
lines.zh: 运输、记忆、完备化。数学上的逆，不自动是可执行的操作。

lines.en: And a geometric repair is not automatically a channel you may use again.
lines.zh: 几何上的修复，也不自动是一条可以反复使用的合法通道。

lines.en: One edge, two endpoints, a phase phi on the edge. There is no loop, so the usual wisdom says there is no invariant.
lines.zh: 一条边，两个端点，边上一个相位 phi。没有环，所以通常的看法是：没有不变量。

lines.en: But fix the phase reference at both ends, and the reading one plus e to the i phi, squared, gives four or zero. Anchored references add invariants: m minus n plus k in all.
lines.zh: 但把两端的相位参考都固定住，读数一加 e 的 i phi 次方的模平方，就会给出四或者零。锚定的参考会增加不变量：总共是 m 减 n 加 k 个。

lines.en: Can intensities recover a loop phase? With one reading, h equal to i and h equal to minus i both give two. Shift the reference by a quarter turn, and they give zero and four.
lines.zh: 强度读数能恢复一个环的相位吗？只读一次，h 等于 i 和 h 等于负 i 都给出二。把参考转过四分之一圈，它们就分别给出零和四。

lines.en: Two readings per loop recover the whole phase transport. But no finite memory can track a phase of infinite order: after m repetitions, h and a phase within pi over m of it end up opposite, two apart.
lines.zh: 每个环两次读数，就能恢复整个相位运输。但没有任何有限记忆能追踪一个无限阶的相位：重复 m 次之后，h 和一个与它相差 pi 除以 m 的相位，会走到正相反的位置，相距二。

lines.en: Walk around a circle whose fiber flips sign once per turn. If the task can read the branch, memory needs two states. If it reads only position, one is enough.
lines.zh: 绕着一个圆走，它上面的纤维每转一圈就翻一次符号。如果任务能读分支，记忆需要两个状态。如果只读位置，一个就够了。

lines.en: Now three branches and two swaps. Six operations, but only three memory states. Doing a then b, or b then a, uses the same moves and lands on the same reading, yet one more a separates them. Counting windings is not enough.
lines.zh: 现在是三个分支、两种交换。六种操作，却只需要三个记忆状态。先 a 后 b，或先 b 后 a，用的步数相同，落在相同的读数上，但再做一次 a 就把它们分开了。只数绕圈数是不够的。

lines.en: Three bits, but you only keep the exclusive-or of each pair. Every local pair looks fine: all eight triples of records pass the pairwise check.
lines.zh: 三个比特，但你只保留每一对的异或。每一对局部看都没问题：全部八种记录三元组都通过逐对检查。

lines.en: Only four come from a real assignment, the ones whose three records sum to zero. One, one, one is locally legal and globally impossible. Compression can break gluing.
lines.zh: 只有四种来自真实的赋值，也就是三条记录之和为零的那些。一一一在局部合法，在整体上却不可能。压缩会破坏拼接。

lines.en: A star with n leaves, and a rule: at most one leaf may be on. Each edge's local statistics can be off by only one over n.
lines.zh: 一个有 n 片叶子的星形图，规则是：至多一片叶子亮着。每条边的局部统计只差一除以 n。

lines.en: Yet the nearest consistent whole can be at distance one. The best repair constant is exactly n, even with no cycles. Measure the error as a sum over edges instead, and it drops to one.
lines.zh: 然而最近的相容整体可以相距一。最优修复常数恰好是 n，即使图里没有环。如果改成把各边误差相加，它就降到一。

lines.en: A three by four grid of costs. Each cell adds its cost to the cheaper of its upper or left neighbor. The answer in the corner is eleven.
lines.zh: 一个三乘四的代价网格。每个格子把自己的代价加到上方或左方较小的那个上。角落里的答案是十一。

lines.en: The same recurrence can run by rows, by columns, or in diagonal waves. Their peak memory is four, three, or up to six. Search all thirty-five possible finished regions, and the minimum peak is three.
lines.zh: 同一个递推可以按行跑、按列跑，或者按对角波跑。它们的峰值记忆分别是四、三，或者高达六。搜遍全部三十五种可能的已完成区域，最小峰值是三。

lines.en: Two bits must be produced one after the other, each step legal on its own. Aim for the outcomes zero zero or one one.
lines.zh: 两个比特必须一个接一个地产生，每一步单独合法。目标是结果为零零或者一一。

lines.en: Step by step, the best you can reach is three quarters. A static table of capacities promises one. Order is a real constraint, and it does not go away with adaptive or random schedules.
lines.zh: 一步一步地做，最好只能达到四分之三。一张静态的容量表承诺的是一。顺序是真实的约束，自适应或随机的调度也消除不了它。

lines.en: A hidden number sits in a two-digit counter. You see only the high digit and can only add one. The low digit leaks out through the carry: the first change at step tau means the low digit was p minus tau.
lines.zh: 一个隐藏的数放在一个两位计数器里。你只看得见高位，只能加一。低位通过进位泄露出来：第一次变化出现在第 tau 步，意味着低位是 p 减 tau。

lines.en: Adaptive looking needs only log two of P reads; the shortest wait needs P minus one. You cannot have both. With the fewest reads, the sharp worst wait is j minus one times two to the j, plus one: seventeen when P is eight.
lines.zh: 自适应地看，只需要 log 二 P 次读取；最短的等待需要 P 减一步。两者不可兼得。在读取次数最少时，尖锐的最坏等待是 j 减一乘以二的 j 次方再加一：当 P 等于八时是十七。

lines.en: Keep only the clock phase and the last reading. With a known schedule, j minus one bits of clock suffice. With a hidden schedule, two runs can end at times seven and fifteen: same phase, different sources.
lines.zh: 只保留时钟相位和最后一次读数。调度已知时，时钟只需要 j 减一个比特。调度隐藏时，两次运行可以分别在时刻七和十五结束：相位相同，来源不同。

lines.en: One extra bit, the parity of full periods, fixes it. And if a fair coin picks the schedule, the phase and reading keep eleven quarters of the three bits: a quarter bit of the source is lost to clock randomness.
lines.zh: 多一个比特，也就是完整周期数的奇偶，就能解决。而如果由一枚公平硬币选择调度，相位和读数只保留三个比特中的四分之十一：来源的四分之一比特，输给了时钟的随机性。

lines.en: Now the clock itself is noisy, off by up to epsilon around the circle. A stored label must disambiguate. The minimum number of labels is the chromatic number of a clash graph.
lines.zh: 现在时钟本身带噪声，在圆周上最多偏 epsilon。一个存下来的标签必须消除歧义。所需标签的最小数目，就是一张冲突图的色数。

lines.en: In one worked case, any single reading has at most ten candidates, yet ten colors cover at most one hundred twenty of the one hundred twenty-one types. Eleven labels are required. Local ambiguity does not set global memory.
lines.zh: 在一个具体例子里，任何一次读数至多有十个候选，然而十种颜色至多覆盖一百二十一种类型中的一百二十种。需要十一个标签。局部的歧义，不决定整体的记忆。

lines.en: Transport needs anchors. Memory is set by the task, not by the loop. Completion names limits that no finite run reaches.
lines.zh: 运输需要锚点。记忆由任务决定，而不是由环决定。完备化给出任何有限运行都到不了的极限。

lines.en: Carry forward exactly what the next legal step will need, and not one bit more.
lines.zh: 只把下一个合法步骤需要的东西带向未来，一个比特也不多。
